starting-off.player: Now I am a knight of the round table, do you have any more quests for me?

starting-off.speaker: King Arthur
starting-off.text: Aha! I'm glad you are here! I am sending out various knights on an important quest. I was wondering if you too would like to take up this quest?

options.text: Tell me of this quest.

steps.player: Tell me of this quest.

steps.speaker: King Arthur
steps.text: Well, we recently found out that the Holy Grail has passed into Gielinor.

steps.speaker: King Arthur
steps.text: This is most fortuitous!

steps.speaker: King Arthur
steps.text: None of my knights ever did return with it last time. Now we have the opportunity to give it another go, maybe this time we will have more luck!
If the player's combat level is less than 50:
Before starting this quest, be aware that your combat level is lower than the recommended level of 50.
If the player's combat level is more than 50:

options.text: Yes.

steps.player: I'd enjoy trying that.

steps.speaker: King Arthur
steps.text: Go speak to Merlin. He may be able to give a better clue as to where it is now you have freed him from that crystal.

steps.speaker: King Arthur
steps.text: He has set up his workshop in the room next to the library.

options.text: No.

steps.player: I may come back and try that later.

steps.speaker: King Arthur
steps.text: Be sure that you come speak to me soon then.

options.text: I am weary of questing for the time being...

steps.player: I am weary of questing for the time being...

steps.speaker: King Arthur
steps.text: Maybe later then?

steps.player: Maybe so.

starting-off-subsequent-dialogue-with-ki.player: I am making progress, but I have not recovered the Grail yet.

starting-off-subsequent-dialogue-with-ki.speaker: King Arthur
starting-off-subsequent-dialogue-with-ki.text: Well, the Grail IS very elusive, it may take some perseverance.

starting-off-subsequent-dialogue-with-ki.speaker: King Arthur
starting-off-subsequent-dialogue-with-ki.text: As I said before, speak to Merlin in the workshop by the library.

talking-to-merlin.player: Hello. King Arthur has sent me on a quest for the Holy Grail. He thought you could offer some assistance.

talking-to-merlin.speaker: Merlin
talking-to-merlin.text: That is a powerful artefact indeed. Returning it here would help Camelot a lot.

talking-to-merlin.speaker: Merlin
talking-to-merlin.text: Due to its nature the Holy Grail is likely to reside in a holy place.

talking-to-merlin.speaker: Merlin
talking-to-merlin.text: I believe there is a holy island somewhere not far away... I'm not entirely sure... I spent too long inside that crystal! Anyway, go and talk to someone over there.

talking-to-merlin.speaker: Merlin
talking-to-merlin.text: I suppose you could also try speaking to Sir Galahad?

talking-to-merlin.speaker: Merlin
talking-to-merlin.text: He returned from the quest many years after everyone else. He seems to know something about it, but he can only speak about those experiences cryptically.

options.text: Thank you for the advice.

steps.player: Thank you for the advice.

options.text: Where can I find Sir Galahad?

steps.player: Where can I find Sir Galahad?

steps.speaker: Merlin
steps.text: Galahad now lives a life of religious contemplation. He lives somewhere west of McGrubor's Wood I think.

talking-to-merlin-updating-king-arthur.player: I am making progress, but I have not recovered the Grail yet.

talking-to-merlin-updating-king-arthur.speaker: King Arthur
talking-to-merlin-updating-king-arthur.text: Well, the Grail IS very elusive, it may take some perseverance.

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Palomedes
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: Hello there adventurer, what do you want of me?

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.player: I'd like some advice on finding the Grail.

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Palomedes
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: Sorry, I cannot help you with that.

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Lucan
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: Hello there adventurer.

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.player: I seek the Grail of legend!

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Lucan
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: I'm afraid I don't have any suggestions...

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.player: Thanks. I'll try and find someone who does.

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Gawain
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: Good day to you!

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.player: I seek the Grail in the name of Camelot!

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Gawain
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: The Grail? That is truly a noble quest indeed. None but Galahad have come close.

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Gawain
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: He used to be one of the Knights of the Round Table, but he mysteriously disappeared many years ago.

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.player: Why would he quit being a Knight?

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Gawain
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: That is a good question.

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Gawain
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: I'm afraid I don't have the answer.

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Kay
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: Good morrow!

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Kay
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: I hear you are questing for the Holy Grail?!

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Kay
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: Unfortunately not, Sirrah.

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Tristram
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: Hail Arthur, King of the Britons!

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Tristram
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: Good luck with that!

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Pelleas
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: Greetings to the court of King Arthur!

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.player: Any suggestions on finding the Grail?

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Pelleas
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: My best guess would be some sort of spell. Merlin is our magic expert. Ask him?

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Pelleas
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: Although having said that, I believe Galahad found its location once...

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.player: Really? Know where I can find him?

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Pelleas
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: I'm afraid not. He left here many moons ago and I know not where he went.

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Bedivere
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: May I help you?

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Bedivere
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: You are looking for the Grail now adventurer?

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Bedivere
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: The best of luck to you! Make the name of Camelot proud, and bring it back to us.

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Lancelot
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: Greetings! I am Sir Lancelot, the greatest Knight in the land! What do you want?

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.player: I am questing for the Holy Grail.

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Lancelot
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: The Grail? Ha! Frankly, friend, you're not in that league.

asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.speaker: Sir Lancelot
asking-the-other-knights-talking-to-sir-.text: You got lucky with freeing Merlin but there's no way a puny wannabe like you is going to find the Holy Grail where so many others have failed.

talking-to-the-high-priest-of-entrana.speaker: High Priest
talking-to-the-high-priest-of-entrana.text: Many greetings. Welcome to our fair island.

talking-to-the-high-priest-of-entrana.player: Hello, I am in search of the Holy Grail.

talking-to-the-high-priest-of-entrana.speaker: High Priest
talking-to-the-high-priest-of-entrana.text: The object of which you speak did once pass through holy Entrana. I know not where it is now however.

talking-to-the-high-priest-of-entrana.speaker: Crone
talking-to-the-high-priest-of-entrana.text: Did you say the Grail? You are a Grail knight, yes? Well you'd better hurry. A Fisher King is in pain.

talking-to-the-high-priest-of-entrana.player: Well I would, but I don't know where I am going!

talking-to-the-high-priest-of-entrana.speaker: Crone
talking-to-the-high-priest-of-entrana.text: Go to where the six heads face, blow the whistle and away you go!

options.text: What are the six heads?

steps.player: What are the six heads?

steps.speaker: Crone
steps.text: The six stone heads have appeared just recently in the world. They all face the point of realm crossing. Find where two of the heads face,

steps.speaker: Crone
steps.text: and you should be able to pinpoint where it is.

options.text: What's a Fisher King?

steps.player: What's a Fisher King?

steps.speaker: Crone
steps.text: The Fisher King is the owner and slave of the Grail...

options.text: Ok, I will go searching.

steps.player: Ok, I will go searching.

steps.speaker: Crone
steps.text: Good luck with that.

options.text: What do you mean by the whistle?

steps.player: What do you mean by the whistle?

steps.speaker: Crone
steps.text: You don't know about the whistles yet? The whistles are easy.

steps.speaker: Crone
steps.text: You will need one to get to and from the Fisher King's realm. They reside in a haunted manor house in Misthalin, though you may not perceive them unless you carry something from the realm of the Fisher

steps.speaker: Crone
steps.text: King...

options.text: What's a Fisher King?
Ok, I will go searching.
What do you mean by the whistle?
The point of realm crossing?

steps.player: The point of realm crossing?

steps.speaker: Crone
steps.text: The realm of the Fisher King is not quite of this reality. It is of a reality very close to ours though... Where it is easiest to cross, THAT is a point of realm crossing.

talking-to-sir-galahad.speaker: Galahad
talking-to-sir-galahad.text: Welcome to my home. It's rare for me to have guests! Would you like a cup of tea? I'll just put the kettle on.
Brother Galahad hangs a kettle over the fire.

options.text: Are you any relation to Sir Galahad?
I'm on a quest to find the Holy Grail!

steps.player: I'm on a quest to find the Holy Grail!

steps.speaker: Galahad
steps.text: Ah... the Grail... yes... that did fill me with wonder! Oh, that I could have stayed forever! The spear, the food, the people...

options.text: So how can I find it?
What are you talking about?

steps.player: What are you talking about?

steps.speaker: Galahad
steps.text: The Grail castle... It's... hard to describe with words. It mostly felt like a dream!

options.text: Why did you leave?

steps.player: Why did you leave?

steps.speaker: Galahad
steps.text: Apparently the time is getting close when the world will need Arthur and his knights of the round table again.

steps.speaker: Galahad
steps.text: And that includes me.

steps.speaker: Galahad
steps.text: Leaving was tough for me, so I took this small cloth from the table as a keepsake.

options.text: Why didn't you bring the Grail with you?

steps.player: Why didn't you bring the Grail with you?

steps.speaker: Galahad
steps.text: ...I'm not sure. Because... it seemed to be... NEEDED in the Grail castle? Half a moment, your cup of tea is ready.
Sir Galahad gives you a cup of tea.
a cup of tea

options.text: So how can I find it?

steps.player: So how can I find it?

steps.speaker: Galahad
steps.text: I did not find it through looking - though admittedly I looked long and hard - eventually, it found me.

options.text: Well, I'd better be going then.

steps.player: Well, I'd better be going then.

steps.speaker: Galahad
steps.text: Half a moment, your cup of tea is ready.
Sir Galahad gives you a cup of tea.
a cup of tea

steps.speaker: Galahad
steps.text: If you do come across any particularily difficult obstacles on your quest, do not hesitate to ask my advice.

steps.speaker: Galahad
steps.text: I know more about the realm of the Grail than many, and I have a feeling you may need to come back and speak to me anyway...

options.text: Do you get lonely here on your own?

talking-to-sir-galahad.text: If the player talked to the High Priest of Entrana first:

options.text: I seek an item from the realm of the Fisher King.

steps.player: I seek an item from the realm of the Fisher King.

steps.speaker: Galahad
steps.text: Funny you should mention that, but when I left there I took this small cloth from the table as a keepsake.

steps.player: I don't suppose I could borrow that? It could come in useful on my quest.

steps.text: Galahad reluctantly passes you a small cloth.
a Holy table napkin

talking-to-sir-galahad-blowing-on-the-ma.text: If the player blows the whistle anywhere besides between the four pillars at Brimhaven:

steps.text: The whistle makes no noise. It will not work in this location.

talking-to-sir-galahad-blowing-on-the-ma.text: If the player blows the whistle whilst inside the Fisher Realm:

steps.text: The player is teleported back to Brimhaven.

encountering-the-black-knight-titan.text: I am the Black Knight Titan! You must pass through me before you can continue in this realm!

options.text: Okay, have at ye oh evil knight!

steps.player: Okay, have at ye oh evil knight!

steps.text: If the player defeats the Black Knight Titan without the excalibur:
Puny mortal... You cannot defeat me...
Maybe you need something more to beat the titan?
The Black Knight Titan's regenerates back to full health.
If the player uses the excalibur to defeat the Black Knight Titan:
Well done! You have defeated the Black Knight Titan!

options.text: Actually I think I'll run away!

steps.player: Actually I think I'll run away!

talking-to-the-fisherman.speaker: Fisherman
talking-to-the-fisherman.text: Hi! I don't get many visitors here!

options.text: How's the fishing?

steps.player: How's the fishing?

steps.speaker: Fisherman
steps.text: Not amazing. Not many fish can live in this gungey stuff. I remember when this was a pleasant river teeming with every sort of fish...

options.text: Any idea how to get into the castle?

steps.player: Any idea how to get into the castle?

steps.speaker: Fisherman
steps.text: Why, that's easy!

steps.speaker: Fisherman
steps.text: Just ring one of the bells outside.

steps.player: ...I didn't see any bells.

steps.speaker: Fisherman
steps.text: You must be blind then. There's ALWAYS bells there when I go to the castle.

options.text: Yes, well, this place is a dump.

steps.player: Yes, well, this place is a dump!

steps.speaker: Fisherman
steps.text: This place used to be very beautiful, however, as our king grows old and weak, the land seems to be dying too.

talking-to-the-fisherman-peasant.speaker: Peasant
talking-to-the-fisherman-peasant.text: Woe is me! Our crops are all failing... how shall I feed myself this winter?

ringing-the-grail-bell.text: If the player rings the Grail bell but is not by the dismantled bricks:

steps.text: Ting-a-ling-a-ling!
Nothing happens.

ringing-the-grail-bell.text: If the player rings the Grail bell and is at least four tiles by the dismantled bricks:

steps.text: Ting-a-ling-a-ling!

steps.speaker: Grail Maiden
steps.text: Welcome to the Grail castle. You should come inside, it's cold out here.
Somehow you are now inside the castle.

ringing-the-grail-bell-taking-the-holy-g.text: You feel that the Grail shouldn't be moved. You must complete some task here before you are worthy.

talking-to-the-fisher-king.speaker: The Fisher King
talking-to-the-fisher-king.text: Ah! You got inside at last! You spent all that time fumbling around outside, I thought you'd never make it here.

options.text: How did you know what I have been doing?

steps.player: How did you know what I have been doing?

steps.speaker: The Fisher King
steps.text: Oh, I can see what is happening in my realm. I have sent clues to help you get here, such as the fisherman, and the crone.

options.text: I seek the Holy Grail.

steps.player: I seek the Holy Grail.

steps.speaker: The Fisher King
steps.text: Ah excellent. A knight come to seek the Holy Grail. Maybe our land can be restored to its former glory.

steps.speaker: The Fisher King
steps.text: At the moment the Grail cannot be removed from the castle. Legend has it a questing knight will one day work out how to restore our land; then he will claim the Grail as his prize.

steps.player: Any ideas how I can restore the land?

steps.speaker: The Fisher King
steps.text: None at all.

options.text: You don't look too well.

steps.player: You don't look too well.

steps.speaker: The Fisher King
steps.text: Nope, I don't feel so good either.

steps.speaker: The Fisher King
steps.text: I fear my life is running short... Alas, my son and heir is not here. I am waiting for my son to return to this castle.

steps.speaker: The Fisher King
steps.text: If you could find my son, that would be a great weight off my shoulders.

steps.player: Who is your son?

steps.speaker: The Fisher King
steps.text: He is known as Percival.

steps.speaker: The Fisher King
steps.text: I believe he is a knight of the round table.

steps.player: I shall go and see if I can find him.

options.text: Do you mind if I have a look around?

steps.player: Do you mind if I have a look around?

steps.speaker: The Fisher King
steps.text: No, not at all. Please, be my guest.

options.text: You don't look too well.

talking-to-king-arthur.player: Hello, do you have a knight named Sir Percival?

talking-to-king-arthur.speaker: King Arthur
talking-to-king-arthur.text: Ah yes. I remember young Percival. He rode off on a quest a couple of months ago. We are getting a bit worried, he's not back yet...

talking-to-king-arthur.speaker: King Arthur
talking-to-king-arthur.text: He was going to try and recover the golden boots of Arkaneeses.

talking-to-king-arthur.player: Any idea which way that would be?

talking-to-king-arthur.speaker: King Arthur
talking-to-king-arthur.text: Not exactly. We discovered some magic golden feathers that are said to point the way to the boots...

talking-to-king-arthur.speaker: King Arthur
talking-to-king-arthur.text: Just blowing gently on them will supposedly show the way to go.
If the player does not have enough inventory space:

steps.speaker: King Arthur
steps.text: Free up some space and I'll give you a feather.

talking-to-king-arthur.text: If the player has one free inventory space:

steps.text: King Arthur gives you a feather.
a Magic gold feather

talking-to-king-arthur.text: If the player loses the feather:

blowing-on-the-magic-gold-feather.text: If the player is directly to the west of the boots:

steps.text: The feather points to the east.

blowing-on-the-magic-gold-feather.text: If the player is directly to the east of the boots:

steps.text: The feather points to the west.

blowing-on-the-magic-gold-feather.text: If the player is directly to north of the boots:

steps.text: The feather points to the south.

blowing-on-the-magic-gold-feather.text: If the player is directly to the south of the boots:

steps.text: The feather points to the north.

blowing-on-the-magic-gold-feather.text: If the player is southeast of the boots:

steps.text: The feather points to the northwest.

blowing-on-the-magic-gold-feather.text: If the player is southwest of the boots:

steps.text: The feather points to the northeast.

blowing-on-the-magic-gold-feather.text: If the player is northeast of the boots:

steps.text: The feather points to the southwest.

blowing-on-the-magic-gold-feather.text: If the player is northwest of the boots:

steps.text: The feather points to the southeast.

blowing-on-the-magic-gold-feather.text: If the player is within 5 tiles away from the boots:

steps.text: The feather points to somewhere nearby.

blowing-on-the-magic-gold-feather.text: If the player blows the feather whilst inside Scrubfoot's Cave or any dungeon:

steps.text: The feather doesn't seem to work here...

blowing-on-the-magic-gold-feather.text: If the player blows the feather whilst inside Sir Percival's house:

steps.text: The feather points at the sacks.

talking-to-sir-percival.text: If the player prods at the sacks:

steps.text: You hear a muffled groan. The sack wriggles slightly.

talking-to-sir-percival.text: If the player attempts to open the sack:

steps.text: You hear muffled noises from the sack. You open the sack.

talking-to-sir-percival.speaker: Sir Percival
talking-to-sir-percival.text: Wow, thank you! I could hardly breathe in there!

options.text: How did you end up in a sack?

steps.player: How did you end up in a sack?

steps.speaker: Sir Percival
steps.text: It's a little embarrassing really.

steps.speaker: Sir Percival
steps.text: After going on a long and challenging quest to retrieve the boots of Arkaneeses, defeating many powerful enemies on the way, I fell into a goblin trap!

steps.speaker: Sir Percival
steps.text: I've been kept as a slave here for the last 3 months!

steps.speaker: Sir Percival
steps.text: A day or so ago, they decided it was a fun game to put me in this sack: then they forgot about me!

steps.speaker: Sir Percival
steps.text: I'm now very hungry, and my bones feel very stiff.
inital

options.text: Come with me, I shall make you a king.

steps.player: Come with me, I shall make you a king.

steps.speaker: Sir Percival
steps.text: What are you talking about?

steps.speaker: Sir Percival
steps.text: The king of where?

steps.player: Your father is apparently someone called the Fisher King. He is dying and wishes you to be his heir.

steps.speaker: Sir Percival
steps.text: I have been told that before.

steps.speaker: Sir Percival
steps.text: I have not been able to find that castle again though...

talking-to-sir-percival.text: If the player does not have the whistle:
If the player has the magic whistle:

steps.player: Well, I do have the means to get us there - a magic whistle!

steps.text: You give a whistle to Sir Percival. You tell sir Percival what to do with the whistle.

steps.speaker: Sir Percival
steps.text: Ok, I will see you there then!

options.text: Your father wishes to speak to you.

steps.player: Your father wishes to speak to you.

steps.speaker: Sir Percival
steps.text: My father? You have spoken to him recently?

steps.player: He is dying and wishes you to be his heir.

steps.speaker: Sir Percival
steps.text: I have been told that before.

steps.speaker: Sir Percival
steps.text: I have not been able to find that castle again though...

talking-to-sir-percival.text: If the player does not have the whistle:
If the player has the magic whistle:

steps.player: Well, I do have the means to get us there - a magic whistle!

steps.text: You give a whistle to Sir Percival. You tell sir Percival what to do with the whistle.

steps.speaker: Sir Percival
steps.text: Ok, I will see you there then!

talking-to-sir-percival-subsequent-dialo.speaker: Sir Percival
talking-to-sir-percival-subsequent-dialo.text: I said I will see you there then!

talking-to-sir-percival-talking-to-sir-p.speaker: King Percival
talking-to-sir-percival-talking-to-sir-p.text: I got here and agreed to take over duties as king here, then before my eyes the most miraculous changes occured here... grass and trees were growing outside before our very eyes!

talking-to-sir-percival-talking-to-sir-p.speaker: King Percival
talking-to-sir-percival-talking-to-sir-p.text: Thank you very much for showing me the way home.
If the player talks to him again:

talking-to-sir-percival-taking-more-than.text: You feel that taking more than one Holy Grail might be greedy...

talking-to-king-arthur-2.speaker: King Arthur
talking-to-king-arthur-2.text: Wow! Incredible! You truly are a splendid knight!

Ss216z.player: Well, I do have the means to get us there - wait, let me go get the magic whistle!
